# Blog notes

Notes for a human author, not a finished post. Every number below has an evidence source in `RESULTS.md`; where a result is unfavourable it is stated plainly.

## The problem

- Notes only: state in your own words why a safe-Rust, decompress-only inflate is worth building, and that comparators implement more (see the parity note below).

## The clean-room setup

- cleanflate has 0 unsafe blocks and 0 unsafe functions and forbids unsafe code at its crate root.
- cleanflate was built from the RFC texts alone; this benchmark repo lifts that rule and reads the comparators.

## What the pipeline built and what it cost

- Three rounds took 28.5 hours of attributed wall-clock time.
- The agents wrote 1,162,532 output tokens across all stages.
- Cost: $361 estimated.
- The cleanflate decompression path is 3,683 lines of Rust code in 17 files.

## Correctness

- cleanflate's output matched the expected SHA-256 and length for 2962 of 2962 streams on M-B, with no disagreement.
- rfc1950/trailing_byte.bin: cleanflate rejects it (TrailingData) while other subjects accept it, by design of its strict defaults.
- rfc1951/valid_stored_trailing_byte.bin: cleanflate rejects it (TrailingData) while other subjects accept it, by design of its strict defaults.
- Every disagreement is cleanflate being stricter than the comparators; none is a comparator rejecting what cleanflate accepts.
- diff_cf_mox on M-B: 340,702 executions, 0 divergences.
- diff_cf_zlib on M-B: 583,504 executions, 0 divergences.
- diff_cf_zrs on M-B: 313,085 executions, 0 divergences.

## What zlib-rs took (context only)

- zlib-rs's first commit: 2023-12-05T05:04:21Z.
- zlib-rs has accumulated this many commits: 1083.
- zlib-rs's contributors, anonymous included: 37.
- zlib-rs's first GitHub release: v0.2.0 (2024-06-12T12:16:19Z).
- Context, not a head-to-head comparison. zlib-rs is a full zlib replacement: complete API and C ABI, compression as well as decompression, SIMD code paths, and performance parity with zlib-ng as a goal. cleanflate (this repo's subject) only decompresses, in safe Rust, without SIMD or a C ABI, and was built in three Foundry rounds; the two efforts have different scopes.
